outcome: return to baseline of vascular anomalies (VA)
cohort: Female adult patients of childbearing age from a single tertiary care centre's Vascular Anomaly clinic in Canada.
finding: Of 16 patients with complex vascular anomalies, 3 of 14 using OCP experienced worsening of their VA, and 12 of 15 who had children experienced variable worsening of their VA during pregnancy, which returned to baseline after delivery or nursing cessation, with 3 women experiencing severe complications.
